description: cfd_2d_cpm_bedload_layer (W 20 1.0) with solid bodies in the bed: a 1 cm block standing 1 cm out of the bed (x 0.045-0.055 m, top z 0.03 m) and a fixed floor under the downstream bed (x 0.07-0.1 m, top z 0.012 m, 8 mm of sand on it). The packed bed takes the solid cells as walls for the gradient of its stress (CPM::stress_gradient: mirrored, as at the domain walls; before, their zero stress pushed the bed into the solid), and a parcel placed in the bed at a level inside a solid goes to the first cell above it (CPM::bedload_place; before, it stayed in the solid cell without a capacity check). In 4000 steps the largest occupancy of a cell stays at the capacity 0.667 (before up to 2.0), and the moves rejected at full cells halve
covers: CPM::bedload_place: a level inside a solid lifted to the first cell above it
